character.appendages: Exactly two long upright ears attached at the crown, deforming with the body. No arms, hands, legs beyond the small forefeet, wings, horn, third ear, floating ornament or tail is permitted.
character.contactAndOrigin: Shared source origin is [23,42] on a 64x64 canvas, from a native bounds union of [-15,-28,33,8]. Compact cells stay low around that origin; the upright, stretched, airborne restrained main035 and displaced main060 defeat cells retain their source-relative offsets without per-cell recentering.
character.faceAndExpression: The pale facial window turns, compresses, inverts and is partly occluded with body angle. The mouth is closed in neutral and rest poses and opens wide showing an upper and lower tooth row in the call, lunge and restrained call poses; a small mouth mark reads at the leading edge in pitched and prone poses. One identical face must not be pasted across poses.
character.locomotion: Motion is driven by whole-body squash and stretch, small translated hops, upright rise to a tall call pose, head-down forward lunges, wide side-lying rest, prone collapse, a back-roll tumble and a displaced defeat pose. Both ears bend, trail, fold back and sweep with the body; they are never used as limbs and no new action meaning may be added.
character.morphology: Very small low round juvenile body, broadest at the base, carrying two long slender upright ears that taper toward the tip. One pale front/side facial window holds the eyes and mouth. There are small forefeet at the ground contact and no arms, hands, wings or tail.
character.restraint: Main cells 025-041 are the donor-specific restrained contract, including aliases main029 and main031 to main025 and main032 to main030. A separate gold-brown external wrap crosses the body through the neutral, lifted, wide-rest, fast-step, open-face and prone states, and sequences 16-25 mirror sequences 0-15 tick for tick. main024 is the unbound pre-restraint low pose.
character.specialStates: Main042 and alias main044 are the saturated warm flash color; main045 is the tall black silhouette and main046 is the compact black silhouette; main059 is stone-gray; main062 is the white evolution silhouette. These should be deterministic wherever the source alpha relation permits, and main059 diverges too far from its base to be derived.
